description:
ImoVertical brings together what French public registers say about an address: local taxation, prices of signed transactions in the area, natural and technological risks, soil pollution, nuisances, town planning and the local development plan, building permits, building fabric and energy performance, co-ownership, transport, schools, shops, health and environment.

The plugin identifies the address and answers one precise question about it, profiles a commune when you are still deciding where to buy, and helps you re-read the reports already on your account, compare them with one another and prepare the questions to ask the estate agent, the seller, the building manager or the notary.

ImoVertical replaces neither a technical survey, nor a notary's opinion, nor legal or financial advice. The absence of an entry in a public registry does not guarantee the absence of the corresponding risk.

defaultPrompt: Quels risques naturels sont recensés à cette adresse ?
Montre-moi le profil de cette commune.
Quelle est la taxe foncière dans cette ville ?
